title: PFD-N1: full-secret all-modulus decoding with exactly n+1 source copies

claims.statement: For every integer N>=2 and every fixed secret s in Z/NZ, let n=ceil(log2 N). PFD-N1 is the single algorithm in proof.md with m=n+1 clean raw copies, q_lab=n+ceil(log2 m)+11, p=ceil(m/2)+26, the specified plus-shift source extraction, coherent two-reflection sign eraser, and negated final shift label. Each of source extraction, sign approximation, total finite-gate synthesis and final rounding has error at most 1/512. It outputs the entire secret with unconditional probability at least Cstar-1/128>43/64>2/3, where Cstar=(1+sqrt(2)+4sqrt(3))^2/128. The same generic configuration includes N=2. Total charged sequential work is O(2^(n/2) n^2 log2 n), including source acquisition, initialization, gate generation, addressing, arithmetic, measurements, resets, precision, all synthesis and all fixed walk repetitions. The exact growth index of this envelope is 1. All four resource bounds hold jointly on every branch, including misrounded labels and unsuccessful outputs. Constants are absolute and independent of N, s and measured outcomes. The structured representative applies for n>=2; n=1 has fixed finite cost.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
